name: What role does a commercial project manager play in budgeting for a luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What role does a commercial project manager play in budgeting for a luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A commercial project manager plays a critical role in budgeting by developing, monitoring, and controlling all project costs. They create detailed cost estimates, solicit and evaluate bids from contractors and suppliers, negotiate contracts, and track expenditures against the approved budget. Their expertise helps identify potential cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and provides transparent financial reporting to the client, ensuring financial discipline throughout the project lifecycle.
acceptedAnswer.description: They develop, monitor, and control project costs by creating estimates, evaluating bids, negotiating contracts, and tracking expenditures to stay within budget.
